About.introTitle: Built for people who want more than another workout plan
About.introLead: Studio Itai was created for people who are ready to train with purpose, structure, and accountability. Not just to sweat for an hour. Not just to follow random exercises. Not just to “try again” every few months.
About.introBody: The studio was built around a simple belief: real progress happens when professional training, personal attention, and consistent guidance work together. A good trainer does not only count repetitions - a good trainer understands the person behind the goal: the schedule, the habits, the injuries, the doubts, the motivation, and the life happening outside the gym. That is the foundation of Studio Itai.
About.storyBody1: Before Studio Itai became a training platform, it started with one trainer, one notebook, and a pattern that kept repeating. Clients would arrive motivated - some wanted strength, some weight loss, some to move without pain, some confidence, some were returning after years away. Others had already tried programs, apps, gyms, and diets that looked good on paper but failed in real life.
About.storyBody2: The problem was rarely effort. The problem was that most people were given plans without context. A generic plan does not know that someone works late three nights a week, has knee discomfort, limited equipment, or only thirty minutes between work and family. It does not notice when someone disappears for two weeks, and it does not adjust when life changes.
About.storyBody3: Itai saw that the strongest results came from a different kind of coaching: clear structure, careful personalization, honest tracking, and direct support between sessions. So Studio Itai evolved - what began as personal coaching became a smarter training experience that combines the discipline of professional coaching with the accessibility of AI-powered support.
About.whatBody: Studio Itai helps clients build personalized workout routines based on their goals, fitness level, schedule, limitations, preferred training location, and available equipment. Each client receives a structured plan designed around real constraints, not ideal conditions. The platform helps clients follow the plan, track completed workouts, write notes after training, and get immediate answers from an AI virtual trainer when they need guidance. The trainer sees progress, the client receives clarity, the plan stays visible, and the work becomes measurable.
About.philosophyLead: Training should be serious, but not confusing. A strong plan should tell the client exactly what to do, why it matters, and how to perform it safely - with the right amount of challenge, enough recovery, and enough flexibility to survive real life. Studio Itai is built around five principles.
About.principle1Body: Every client starts with onboarding that captures goals, current fitness level, physical limitations, available days, preferred workout environment, equipment, and personal notes. The plan is built from the person outward, not from a template downward.
About.principle2Body: Workouts are organized clearly: exercises, sets, repetitions or duration, rest times, instructions, and safety notes. Clients should never feel lost when opening their plan.
About.principle3Body: Progress is tracked. Completed workouts are logged. Notes are saved. Consistency becomes visible, both to the client and to the trainer.
About.principle4Body: Technology supports the coach - it does not replace the coach. Itai can monitor client progress, review workout logs, read training notes, check AI chat history, and contact clients directly when personal guidance is needed.
About.principle5Body: The platform respects limitations and injuries. It does not pretend to diagnose medical issues; when pain, injury, or medical concerns appear, the guidance stays responsible and encourages professional care when needed.
About.aiTitle: Why AI is part of the experience
About.aiBody: AI is used to make coaching faster, clearer, and more responsive. It helps generate structured workout plans from onboarding data, answer client questions between sessions, explain exercises, and suggest safer alternatives. But AI is not treated as magic: every AI-generated plan must follow a predictable structure, and every answer is based on the client's goal, fitness level, current plan, and known limitations. The purpose is simple - give clients faster help while keeping the trainer informed.
About.differentBody: Studio Itai is not a generic fitness app. It is a coaching system built around one professional trainer's standard of care. Clients are not left alone with a static PDF - they receive a living training experience: onboarding, plan generation, workout tracking, feedback, AI chat, reminders, and trainer oversight. Itai can see who is training consistently, who is slowing down, who needs support, and which plans need adjustment. That creates a tighter feedback loop between intention and action.
About.forClientsBody: Studio Itai gives you a clear path. You know what to train, when to train, and how to perform the exercises. You can track your progress, ask questions, and receive a plan that fits your life instead of fighting against it.
About.forTrainerBody: Studio Itai gives the trainer operational visibility. Itai can monitor clients, review progress, inspect logs, read workout notes, review AI conversations, create and edit plans, duplicate templates, regenerate plans when circumstances change, and keep private trainer notes. This lets the coaching relationship stay personal even as the number of clients grows.
About.missionBody: The mission of Studio Itai is to make personal training more structured, more intelligent, and more human. Fitness does not change people because of one perfect workout - it changes people through repeated action, clear guidance, trust, and attention. Studio Itai exists to make that process easier to follow, easier to measure, and harder to abandon.
About.missionPillars: Professional coaching. Personal attention. Smart support. Consistent progress.
